# PocketKernel 1.0 FVP requirements matrix

The staging branch is not eligible for merge until every required source, test, binary, package, and real-device gate from the canonical 30-section specification is verified. A green build alone is not completion.

- [ ] Full declarative domain and package integrity
- [ ] Bounded expression and binding engine
- [ ] Every component renders real behavior
- [ ] Every action performs its named behavior
- [ ] Multi-screen Foundation Models generation with deterministic CI mock
- [ ] Manual builder and five complete templates
- [ ] SQLite records, permissions, activity, metadata, rollback, and recovery
- [ ] Home, Create, Library, Activity, and Settings complete
- [ ] Domain, runtime, persistence, package, and UI tests pass
- [ ] ARM64 unsigned IPA validation passes
- [ ] Signed iPhone 16 acceptance sequence passes
